title: InsideEVs: 2021 Tesla Model 3 LR AWD With 82 kWh Battery: Charging Analysis
notes: Mark Kane, 2021-07-10, from Bjørn Nyland's tests (Europe, Tesla V3 Supercharger). LR AWD power chart: https://cdn.motor1.com/images/custom/img-tesla-model-3-lr-awd-2021-v3-sc-dcfc-power-20210710.png; the comparison chart https://cdn.motor1.com/images/custom/img-tesla-model-3-lr-awd-2021-v3-sc-dcfc-power-comparison-20210710.png also carries the 2021 Performance AWD (black line). Text: LR peak 249 kW, 20-80 % avg 94 kW; Performance peak 233 kW, 20-80 % avg 90 kW; pack 76.5 kWh net / 82 kWh total, "supposedly" Panasonic cells; build location not stated. The article's average-power matrix (an image) was read too and agrees with the LR curve (20-25 % avg 217 kW, 50-55 % avg 89 kW); a text-only check cannot verify it.
